trend: PNAS mouse study (Princeton, Ludwig Institute): gut bacteria starved of fibre start digesting the gut's mucus lining
why: Read-past-the-headline education. Clear that it is a mouse study, practical Indian food takeaway, no product.
text:
A mouse study making the rounds: gut bacteria starved of fibre start feeding on the gut's own mucus lining.

It was in mice, so it says little yet about people. The sensible move is the same either way: more dal, fruit and whole grains.

How's your fibre today?
